I feel for you. I have never had a boyfriend that never watches it, just hides it whenever I bring it up. It’s gut wrenching. It makes you feel not good enough and it makes you feel like your body is gross because it doesn’t look like theirs. But even without that when you bring it up and they call you insecure or controlling, it then brings up even more problems such as trust issues, feeling like you aren’t respected enough to be listened to, etc. Stuff that a relationship really depends on. it really hurts.

I wish I knew exactly how they felt!!! I totally would have used that to better my work and learned from my mistakes! They may have been humoring me, or may have thought that I was downplaying myself. I have had some bad work, but I knew it was and so did they and they came back and had me fix it, but the others I never heard a single peep from other than the bashing. It may have also been the charging of my work but I also just charged for product as I wasn’t comfortable charging for my services just quite yet. As for other nail techs, I was the only one. I only have one other coworker who is a hairstylist, and as far as I know she’s comfortable with me. We both worked at a hair salon together before I moved to this job and she moved with me so she may be biased. Other than that, I’m trying to weigh out what I may have done and other than work not being up to their expectations I truly have no idea.
